components.description: UM System Collected Rule 340.010: up to 12 workweeks of job-protected unpaid FMLA leave in a 12-month period for the birth or placement of a child, the employee's own serious health condition (pregnancy incapacity included), or care of a family member; faculty pay during it comes from 340.070 (c2).
components.faculty_group_note: eligible faculty and staff employees of the University
components.eligible_parent_wording: The birth of a child or placement of a child with the employee for adoption or foster care; the employee's own serious health condition; care of the employee's spouse
components.entitlement_note: Statutory leave (FMLA): guaranteed even though the policy says 'may take' and requires notice (schema §2c).
components.duration_note: Up to 12 workweeks in a 12-month period (29 U.S.C. 2612(a)(1): 'a total of 12 workweeks'). 340.070 restates the cap for faculty: no more than 12 weeks of family and medical leave in any 12-month period. Covered-service-member caregiver leave (26 workweeks) is not a parent provision.
components.service_requirement: 12 months and 1,250 hours in the preceding 12 months
components.time_window: leaves for birth or adoption must be taken with 12-months of the event
components.notice: 30 days advance notice when foreseeable; otherwise as soon as practicable
components.medical_certification_note: Health care provider's certification for the employee's own serious health condition or a family member's; a return-to-work statement is required after the employee's own serious health condition, including after the birth of a child. None stated for bonding leave.
components.relief_note: A leave of absence; relief not stated, so every duty relieved (R9).

sequence.note: R3b: a faculty member returning from family and medical leave mid-semester is not expected back in the classroom until a new term; with a negotiated differentiated workload, pay for the remainder of the semester. Relief coded as the semester, containing the leave.

notes: 2018_01 (Missouri S&T HR Benefits page) is an index/navigation page for leave: it links to the Faculty Leave Policy (saved as 2018_00), FMLA HR Policy 407 and its Q & A, FMLA Guidelines, Leave Policy HR 408 and its Q & A, a Leave of Absence Request Form and vacation accrual information; none of the linked HR documents is saved. It holds no leave policy text itself.

Governing documents: UM System Collected Rules 340.070 (faculty leave, amended 2-9-17), 340.010 (FMLA, 2-9-17; 340.070.B.2 controls in any inconsistency), 310.025 (probationary extension, amended 2-9-17) and 340.030 (sick leave, amended 9-13-13; next amendment 6-21-18, after the reference date). All system-wide rules that apply to the Rolla campus (V3c); no campus-level leave policy saved.

Member's path (U8): an academic-year tenure-stream faculty member with two years' service is FMLA-eligible, so 340.070's Paid Family and Medical Leave applies (up to 12 weeks paid, during normally scheduled work duties). A faculty member 'covered by another approved University vacation/sick leave policy' is paid under that policy instead; the 340.030 sick-leave rule covers staff and certain non-regular academic employees, not regular faculty (c8, c9 flagged excludes_main_faculty).

Not components: Research, Development and Sabbatical Leaves (340.070) exist for scholarly and professional development and are not usable for a birth or adoption; Military Leave (340.070 pointer to 340.010 and the HR Policy Manual) is not a parent provision.

Leave limit not recorded as leave_limits: 340.070's 'Under no circumstance can a faculty member exceed 12 weeks of family and medical leave within any 12-month period' restates the FMLA leave's own length (c1, with its pay c2 within it); the unpaid Leave of Absence (c7) is expressly for leave beyond FMLA, so the limit caps no other component.

Chain, birth parent: FMLA leave 12 workweeks (c1) with Paid Family and Medical Leave up to 12 weeks within it (c2) -> on a mid-semester return, relief from classroom teaching for the balance of the semester, containing the leave: paid with a negotiated differentiated workload (c3, negotiated) in lieu of the unpaid default (c4, consecutive_after c1). Tenure clock +1 year after FML > 6 weeks (c5).

Chain, non-birth parent: the same as the birth parent: FMLA leave 12 (c1) with paid FML within it (c2) -> balance of the semester out of the classroom (c3 negotiated, paid, containing the leave; or c4 unpaid). Leaves for birth or adoption must be taken within 12 months of the event.

Cited but not saved: FMLA HR Policy 407 and its Q & A; FMLA Guidelines; Leave Policy HR 408 and its Q & A; Leave of Absence Request Form; the HR Policy Manual (military leave); the University's Retirement, Disability, and Death Benefit Plan (340.070) and long-term disability plan (340.010); 340.020 Leave of Absence (navigation link 'Next Rule' in 340.010; 340.010 also refers faculty to 'applicable Collected Rules and Regulations' on leaves of absence); 340.060 Personal Days (navigation link only); HR policies 303 and 309 (educational assistance, not leave).
